Name: Rose and Wisteria SVE Buildings
Author: deleted107871763
Description:
[center][size=3][b]===

This mod retextures the SVE town buildings to match Wangwangmung's Rose and Wisteria Village Buildings Retexture mod.[/b]

[b]-Installation-
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI, CP and SVE.
2. Unzip the mod folder into your game mods folder (Stardew Valley/Mods).[/b]

[/size]-[b][size=3]Credits[/size][/b]-[size=3]

and for giving me permission to use her assets to make and upload this mod.
